desc:
FRUIT FLAVORED SNACKS: Enjoy delicious Gushers Fruit Flavored Snacks in Strawberry and Tropical flavors; Variety Pack bursting with yummy liquid

FUN KIDS SNACK: These individually wrapped snack bags are the perfect treat to include in a packed school lunch box

GLUTEN FREE: Tasty gummy treats made without gluten or gelatin; Each serving is a good source of vitamin C

ON-THE-GO SNACK: These Fruit Flavored Snacks are the perfect addition to your pantry and a snack every member of the family will love

CONTAINS: One 4.8 oz box of Gushers Tropical and Strawberry Fruit Flavored Snacks; Six 0.8 oz pouches
features:
Features

Juicy Liquid Centers

Each piece contains a chewy outer shell and a gooey, flavorful liquid core that "gushes" when bitten.

Two Fan-Favorite Flavors

Includes both Strawberry Splash (a sweet berry burst) and Tropical (zesty island-inspired taste).

Individual Single-Serve Pouches

Packaged in convenient 0.8 oz pouches—easy to stash in bags, lunchboxes, or pockets.

Fortified with Vitamin C

Delivers roughly 10% of daily vitamin C per pouch for a small nutritional boost

Gluten-Free, Gelatin-Free, Dairy-Free

Suitable for a variety of dietary preferences, including vegan and gluten-sensitive diets.

Kosher Certified

Produced under kosher dietary standards.

Benefits

Fun and Interactive Eating

Children and adults love the surprise of the gooey center—it adds playfulness to snack time.

Portable & Mess-Free

No spoon needed, no spills—just open and enjoy anywhere.

Variety Keeps It Exciting

Two different flavors in one pack keep snack time fresh and pleasing for all tastes

Kid-Approved Flavor Experience

Both flavors are popular, making this variety pack a crowd-pleaser.

Quick Vitamin Boost

With added vitamin C, it's a bit more nutritious than plain candy.
